CT / CECT Findings

Study Source Findings
Pre-chemo CECT chest and abdomen, AIIMS, 03-Feb-2026 Ill-defined heterogeneously enhancing solid mass with internal hypoenhancing necrotic areas in left adnexa measuring approximately 6.6 × 5.7 × 6.3 cm; left ovary not seen separately. Lesion extending up to midline closely abutting uterine fundus and body with loss of fat planes and without gross infiltration. Laterally abutting left external iliac vein without encasement/infiltration. Minimal free fluid surrounding mass. Few small subcentimetric omental nodules and reticulations with mild peritoneal thickening seen - s/o early omental and peritoneal deposits. Defect approx. 13 × 14 mm at umbilicus with herniation of preperitoneal fat.
Post-chemo CECT chest & abdomen, outside, 01-Jun-2026 Large predominantly hypodense cystic left adnexal mass lesion within pelvis measuring approximately 7.2 × 7.6 × 8.8 cm. Heterogeneously enhancing internal solid components and thin enhancing septations, predominantly along posterior wall and inferior aspect. Lesion extends up to midline and abuts uterine fundal region with indistinct fat planes; also abuts left lateral urinary bladder wall and left external iliac vascular compartment without evidence of bladder invasion, vascular encasement, or luminal compression. Distal and mid left ureter closely related; no significant compression/upstream hydroureteronephrosis. Mild free fluid surrounding lesion. Mild omental heterogeneity predominantly in right hemiabdomen without discrete omental nodules or definite peritoneal deposits. No bowel wall involvement. Few subcentimetric homogeneously enhancing left iliac lymph nodes without pathologically enlarged pelvic, retroperitoneal, or inguinal lymphadenopathy. Mild dependent subsegmental atelectatic changes in basal segments of both lower lobes; no pulmonary nodule/mass; no pleural/pericardial effusion.
